config.lorian_arch_orbit.title: Lorian’s Arch Orbit
config.lorian_arch_orbit.reach_extension: Enable the client side of extended block interaction. A compatible server is still required.
config.lorian_arch_orbit.palette_wheel.e: Enable the primary and secondary item palette wheels.
config.lorian_arch_orbit.smart_pick.enab: Tap for vanilla pick block, or briefly hold to open the smart-pick wheel.
config.lorian_arch_orbit.connected_textu: Repairs missing end faces between connected block models.
config.lorian_arch_orbit.invisible_block: Enable client-side visualization controls for barriers and light blocks.
config.lorian_arch_orbit.reach_extension: Requested distance from 5 to 128 blocks. The server-confirmed value remains authoritative.
config.lorian_arch_orbit.connected_textu: Repairs inner wall-arm faces for vanilla and mod blocks using the standard wall states.
Repairs joining faces for vanilla and mod blocks using the standard bed states.
Repairs joining faces for vanilla and mod blocks using the standard door states.
Repairs the contacting faces of extended normal and sticky piston bases and heads.
Completes the four narrow Nether Portal edge faces.
Completes the End Portal bottom and four side faces.
config.lorian_arch_orbit.palette_wheel.a: Choose clockwise reveal, simultaneous expansion, or no animation.
config.lorian_arch_orbit.palette_wheel.p: Select the built-in layout used for a new primary wheel file and Restore Defaults. Existing custom content is not overwritten.
config.lorian_arch_orbit.palette_wheel.s: Select the built-in layout used for a new secondary wheel file and Restore Defaults. Existing custom content is not overwritten.
config.lorian_arch_orbit.palette_wheel.e: Edit primary and secondary groups. Draft changes are written only when Save is pressed.
config.lorian_arch_orbit.smart_pick.mode: Choose adjacent, range, or contextual candidate selection.
config.lorian_arch_orbit.smart_pick.scan: Maximum radius around the targeted block; the supported maximum is 3.
config.lorian_arch_orbit.smart_pick.cand: Maximum contextual candidates shown, from 8 to 24.
config.lorian_arch_orbit.smart_pick.hold: Milliseconds before Pick Block enters smart-pick mode; defaults to 100.
config.lorian_arch_orbit.smart_pick.hist: Give a small contextual score bonus to recently selected materials.
config.lorian_arch_orbit.smart_pick.debu: Log visited positions, valid samples, unique candidates, scored candidates, and scan time. Disabled by default.
config.lorian_arch_orbit.invisible_block: Remember whether supported invisible blocks are currently shown.
Include barrier blocks when visualization is active.
Include light blocks and their level when visualization is active.
Allow enabled features to display compact contextual HUD elements.
config.lorian_arch_orbit.restore_default: Reset every option in this screen to its safe default. Changes apply only after Save.
config.lorian_arch_orbit.error.yacl_miss: YACL is required to open the configuration screen.
config.lorian_arch_orbit.error.reload: Configuration reload failed; the last valid values remain active.
